description: Read an artist's page on Bide & Musique: the names they recorded under, what the catalogue notes about them, and every song of theirs the collection holds, each with its year. Takes the 'artist_id' that search_songs, get_song and get_random_song return. An artist page is a way into a discography rather than a biography: half of them state nothing beyond the name, and the median artist has one record here. Fields the page does not state come back null or empty, which is the ordinary state of this catalogue rather than a failed read. The date of birth comes back exactly as written, since the catalogue states a full date, a bare year, or a date with a death beside it. Nationality is free text for the same reason. Rows come in the site's order, by year of release, never by importance. When you show an artist to a user, credit Bide & Musique and link the page.

artist_id.description: The artist id returned by search_songs, get_song or get_random_song, digits only, for example '290'.

limit.description: Maximum songs of the discography to return.

name: get_artist

aliases.description: Other names this artist recorded under, as the page stacks them.

birth_date.description: Exactly as published, which may be a day, a bare year, a month and a year, or a date with a death beside it. Nothing here is parsed into a date.

programming.description: How the song sits in the station's programming, in the site's own French wording.

song_id.description: Pass this to get_song for the record itself.

links.description: Addresses off the site, with the label the page gave them.

nationality.description: As the catalogue writes it, in its own words: 'suisse', 'franco-espagnole'.

title: Read an artist's page
